Initial release of guaikei抖音批量视频抓取

- Implements CLI commands for Douyin public data collection: keyword search, creator post lists, video comments, and real-time hot rankings.
- Supports use cases such as content research, competitor analysis, comment sentiment mining, and trending topic tracking on Douyin.
- Enforces strict token validation and output rules for compliance (no sensitive or promotional content in runtime output).
- Outputs structured JSON for easy downstream analysis; error handling and logging included.
- Only supports Douyin public data; not suitable for video publishing, watermark removal, or other platforms.
